content: ES module scripts are fetched with CORS mode by default, unlike classic scripts. Opening an HTML file directly via file:// gives each file a null origin, so module script fetches are blocked by CORS/Same-Origin Policy even for same-folder files — the page must be served over http(s) by a local/static server. Confirmed cross-browser (Chrome, Safari) issue; Safari also has extra cross-origin restrictions in some versions requiring a dev-menu 'Disable cross-origin restrictions' toggle for local testing.
